title: Identification of Interacting Proteins Using BioID2 in Trypanosoma brucei
author: Jan Pyrih
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bdrri556

steps.title: Prepare required buffers
steps.instruction: Make all buffers with the compositions listed below.

substeps.instruction: SBG: 150 mM NaCl, 20 mM Glucose, 20 mM NaH2PO4, pH 7.9.
DTE: 1 mM Tris, 1 mM EDTA, pH 8.0.
STM: 250 mM sucrose, 20 mM Tris, pH 8.0, 20 mM MgCl2, 2 mM (other component as written).
Boiling buffer: 50 mM Tris, 1 mM EDTA, 1 % SDS, pH 7.4.
Incubation buffer: 150 mM NaCl, 50 mM Tris, 5 mM EDTA, 1 % Triton X‑100, pH 7.4.

steps.title: Tag protein with BioID2
steps.instruction: Fuse the protein of interest to the linker‑BioID2 tag according to the protocol in the accompanying PPTX file.

steps.title: Supplement media with biotin
steps.instruction: Add 100 µM biotin to SDM‑79 medium and incubate the cells overnight.

steps.title: Verify biotinylation by IFA
steps.instruction: Perform immunofluorescence assay on biotin‑supplemented cells using Alexa‑488‑streptavidin to confirm successful biotinylation.

steps.title: Harvest cells
steps.instruction: Spin down 3 × 10⁹ cells per replicate at 1 500 × g for 15 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Resuspend in SBG and re‑spin
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellets in 50 mL of SBG, then spin again at 1 500 × g for 15 min at 4 °C (same condition as before).

steps.title: Resuspend in DTE
steps.instruction: Resuspend each pellet in 3 mL of DTE.

steps.title: Add sucrose and homogenize
steps.instruction: Add 0.5 mL of 60 % sucrose to each sample, dounce‑mix, and split the suspension into three 1.5 mL Eppendorf tubes.

steps.title: Centrifuge lysate
steps.instruction: Spin the tubes at 16 000 × g for 10 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Resuspend pellets in STM
steps.instruction: Combine the three pellets and resuspend in 1.5 mL of STM (use 2 mL Eppendorf tubes for the merge).

steps.title: Add divalent cations and DNase
steps.instruction: Add MgCl₂ to a final concentration of 5 mM, CaCl₂ to 0.5 mM, and DNase to 5 µg mL⁻¹.

steps.title: Incubate on ice
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture on ice for 20 min.

steps.title: STE wash three times
steps.instruction: Perform three successive washes:

substeps.instruction: Add 1.5 mL of STE buffer, centrifuge at 12 000 × g for 10 min at 4 °C.
Repeat the addition, spin, and removal two more times.

steps.title: Boil samples in buffer
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellets in 1.8 mL of boiling buffer, incubate 10 min at 80 °C.

steps.title: Centrifuge post‑boil
steps.instruction: Spin at 16 000 × g for 10 min at 20 °C.

steps.title: Wash Dynabeads twice
steps.instruction: While the above spin is running, wash 50 µL of Dynabeads™ MyOne™ Streptavidin C1 per sample twice:

substeps.instruction: Resuspend beads in 1 mL incubation buffer, incubate 5 min, then collect beads.

steps.title: Combine supernatant with incubation buffer
steps.instruction: Mix the supernatants obtained in step 15 with 18 mL of incubation buffer supplemented with Roche Complete protease inhibitor cocktail (EDTA‑free).

steps.title: Add Dynabeads to sample
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL of the washed Dynabeads (equivalent to 0.5 mg of beads; stock concentration 10 mg mL⁻¹) resuspended in incubation buffer to each sample.

steps.title: Rotate binding then overnight
steps.instruction: Roll the tubes for 2 h at room temperature, then place the tubes on a refrigerator (4 °C) overnight.

steps.title: Wash beads with boiling buffer
steps.instruction: Wash the beads three times with 1.5 mL of boiling buffer.

steps.title: Wash beads with incubation buffer
steps.instruction: Wash the beads three times with 1.5 mL of incubation buffer.

steps.title: Dry beads and store at –80 °C
steps.instruction: Remove all liquid, leave the beads dry, and store them at –80 °C (optionally snap‑freeze with liquid nitrogen before storage).
